title: --add-only: add, never remove
summary: From v0.2-dev1 (26 Nov 2026), xtp and firewall reconcile take --add-only. Every provider plug-in then adds the missing sources and removes none: a source a full reconcile would remove stays, and the plan prints NOTE kept (add-only): CIDR. On OCI security lists duplicate entries stay too. On Azure and GCP the update sends the union of the rule's current sources and the wanted ones; an Azure rule already open to * gets nothing added. Grid rule R8 (XTP through the firewalls) is additions only, so every R8 order uses --add-only.
authority: architecture Tom Dyer; ooRexx Cloud Control coded by Claude (Opus 5.5), 7 Nov 2026; v0.2-dev3 fixes by Claude (Opus 5.5) at Tom Dyer's instruction ("fix cloud controller", 26 Nov 2026 10:50); v0.1-dev4 bash adapters by ChatGPT/Codex
invariants: Kept sources are always listed as NOTE lines
procedure: Add --add-only to every R8 xtp command
Count REMOVE lines in the plan: must be 0
